interpretation.name: TightenVariantFastenersWithSharedNutrunner
interpretation.goal: Bring the shared nutrunner NR7 to line 4's station and tighten, evaluate and record the fasteners of line 4's forklift variant. This cannot be planned because line 4 is not defined in the runtime plant state (only lines 1, 2 and 3 exist), so its station and variant are unknown.
constraints: Line 4 must exist in the runtime plant state with a defined station and variant before a Recipe can be proposed (E7).
Only one requester may hold NR7. The tool must be reserved before use and released afterwards (E1).
transport-tool Steps must be delegated to executor agvexecutor (E2).
NR7 is currently in the crib. It must reach the station before configure-tool or tighten-fasteners runs (E3).
The tightening program must be obtained only from get-program for the variant, with no literal torque or tolerance values (E4).
Every tightening must be evaluated against its program and recorded for traceability (E5).
Every tool-using Step renews the lease and depends on the reserve-tool Step (E6).
interpretation.horizon: current request, once line 4's station and variant are defined

findings.message: all requested capabilities are grounded in sigma_i
